messages.body: Weighbridge shows 7.2% less than the awarded indicative quantity. Requesting pro-rata adjustment on the balance payment as per clause 6.
Acknowledged. We have requested the yard weighment slips and CCTV weighbridge log from MSTC. Expect an update within 2 working days.

subject: Gate pass delay at BHEL Trichy

messages.body: Trucks waited 6 hours at Gate 2 on lifting day. Requesting waiver of ground rent for one day.
Seller has confirmed the delay was on the yard side. One day ground-rent waiver approved and reflected in your ledger.
